episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.summary: When Chris goes to pick up his sister Janine from the airport, two men follow him. In the parking garage, the gangsters try to kidnap Chris. The police officer can't make sense of the incident.

episodes.title: Lieben und Leben lassen
episodes.summary: When Chris goes to pick up his sister Janine from the airport, two men follow him. In the parking garage, the gangsters try to kidnap Chris. The police officer can't make sense of the incident.

episodes.title: Wer einmal Lügt
episodes.summary: Fourteen-year-old Mario doesn't trust his mother's new boyfriend. He thinks he saw him with a gun. After an accident, Ben and Semir get to know the boy and take a closer look at his family.

episodes.title: Auf eigene Faust
episodes.summary: Fourteen-year-old Mario doesn't trust his mother's new boyfriend. He thinks he saw him with a gun. After an accident, Ben and Semir get to know the boy and take a closer look at his family.

episodes.title: Am Ende der Jugend
episodes.summary: After Chris Ritter's death, Semir gets a new partner: Ben Jäger, a young, daring guy for whom the highway police is just a stepping stone. Can Semir rely on him?

episodes.title: Rabenmutter
episodes.summary: Years ago, Ben and Semir's boss Anna Engelhardt had an affair with the head of a police academy. Now the past is catching up with her, and the two men's paths cross in dramatic fashion.

episodes.title: Schattenmann
episodes.summary: When Ben goes to a jewelry store to have his watch repaired, he finds himself in the middle of a robbery with hostages. During the investigation, Semir and Ben realize that a complicated family tragedy is behind the crime.

episodes.title: Unter Druck
episodes.summary: Highway patrolman Ben unsuspectingly stumbles upon a hostage situation at watchmaker Jörg Bauer's shop. But the supposed robbery turns out to be an old score that the gangster has to settle with Bauer.

episodes.title: Wer einmal lügt
episodes.summary: By jumping off a bridge, laundromat operator Tarik causes an accident. Ben and Semir discover that the apparent suicide was actually a cold-blooded murder. They track down a gang of protection racketeers.

episodes.title: Der Verrat
episodes.summary: Ben and Semir are shot at in their patrol car. However, the attack was intended for a young VIP hostess. When Ben's great love, prosecutor Saskia Ehrbach, is murdered, the police officers must overcome their first crisis as colleagues.

episodes.title: Leibwächter
episodes.summary: Ben and Semir suspect that a professional hitman has been hired to kill businessman Kurban Said. After a failed assassination attempt, the police discover that they have apparently been following the wrong lead the entire time.

episodes.title: Begraben
episodes.summary: The dangerous criminal Wolf Mahler has escaped from prison and wants revenge on Ben, whom he believes is responsible for his daughter's death. He kidnaps Ben and buries him alive. For Semir, a race against time begins.

episodes.title: Im Aus
episodes.summary: Ben is certain that he witnessed a murder in the building opposite his apartment, but no one believes him. In his search for evidence, he becomes increasingly entangled in a murderous conspiracy.

episodes.title: Die Braut
episodes.summary: At the university's history department, a professor is shot dead during a robbery and part of a valuable treasure map is stolen. The murder investigation brings Ben face to face with his ex-girlfriend Katrin.

episodes.title: Genies unter sich
episodes.summary: Little Felix causes an accident because he draws a picture of the solar system on the highway. Ben and Semir take care of the boy and discover that his mother has been the victim of a crime. What happened? Felix has turned into

episodes.title: Die Schwarze Madonna
episodes.summary: The hunt for the past turns out to be a trip full of surprises, including Ben's ambitious ex-girlfriend Katrin...

episodes.title: Unversöhnlich
episodes.summary: Semir and Vicky have to deal with a criminal organization from Belgium that kidnaps people and tortures them in truck container prisons. The highway inspectors must work with the Belgian police to locate the prisons. When the head of the criminal organization launches a counterattack, Semir and Vicky get caught up in a war that has been going on for years between organized crime and the police in Belgium.

episodes.title: Machtlos
episodes.summary: Semir and Vicky have not been able to prove that Miloš and Ivo Savic have sold cocaine. After two attacks on Ivo, the commissioners find the assassin, but Semir shoots him in self-defense. Who is targeting the Savic brothers? Investigations reveal that a militia wants to evict the brothers. But drug lord Miloš strikes back and the inspectors find themselves caught between two unscrupulous parties who are determined to do anything.

episodes.title: Schutzlos
episodes.summary: A young woman falls into the clutches of a group of misogynistic men who indulge in violent fantasies. In order to save her life, Semir and Vicky have to find her in time. But Semir is not officially back in the police service yet. Vicky, on the other hand, enjoys life with a new donor kidney and doesn't shy away from any risk at work, which soon puts her in the group's sights. Will the two stop violence against women?
